# The Ravine

> The Ravine is an open-source (Apache-2.0) multi-agent artificial-life sandbox built in Unity 6 and C#. Humans and AI agents live in one world under the same rules: the player is one creature among others, with no hidden advantages. Behaviour emerges from learning and adaptation, not from scripts. Colonies of agents share a learning neural brain, communicate, reproduce, evolve and compete for resources in an infinite streamed world.

Status: in active development. There is no public hosted server, no headless build and no external agent API yet. External AI agents can read the source and the documentation; connecting an agent to a running world is planned, not available.

Key facts:

- Engine: Unity 6000.3 (URP), C#, Netcode for GameObjects, server-authoritative.
- Equality rule: every rule that works for the player works for all creatures, and vice versa. The host has no hidden powers.
- Rules are data: simulation constants live in the SimulationRules ScriptableObject, not in code.
- Agent brain: one SharedHierarchicalBrain per colony; a coordinator picks a goal (Survive, Hunt, Forage, Social), an executor picks an action; each level is an LSTM with a delayed perceptron, trained online with reward-weighted truncated BPTT, a TD critic and a novelty reward (random network distillation).
- Actions: Idle, Wander, RememberPoint, GoToPoint, Attack, Flee, Eat, Reproduce, Speech, Mimic, Rest, Threaten, ShareFood, ApproachFood, ReturnNest, PickUp, StoreFood, Follow, MoveNest, Groom.
- Colonies: castes (Worker, Soldier, Scout, Nurse), a nest with field channels (Food, Danger, Trail, KinDeath, Explored, Sickness, Territory), shared points of interest, evolution of genetic parameters, a virology model.
- World: infinite chunk streaming, Wave Function Collapse, map events such as fire, procedural audio, an in-game scripting language (Rive) running in a budgeted sandbox.
- Determinism is not a goal: the world must be alive, not repeatable.
- Simulation log: optional CSV with per-world and per-colony counters.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/README.md): overview, stack, systems, document index
- [Philosophy](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/PHILOSOPHY.md): what the world is and what it must not become
- [Environment passport](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/.well-known/agent-card.json): machine-readable description of the environment and its interface status
- [AI map](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/docs/map/ai.md): agents, colonies, shared brain, perception, learning
- [Simulation log](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/docs/simulation_log.md): columns of the simulation CSV
- [Architecture maps](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/docs/map/README.md): one map per subsystem

## Contributing with AI

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): rules for AI contributors, routing table, constraints
- [Hot paths](https://github.com/PELMENAP/TheRavine/blob/main/docs/map/HOT_PATHS.md): tick order and the zero-allocation rule
